info.title: hydromart-digital read API for the AI web
info.description:
HD-6, foundation (H1), the money metrics (H2), the customer, delivery and gallon groups (H3), the stock and loyalty groups (H4) and the franchise, legal-entity and HR groups (H5). The numbers behind the AI web's answers. Every route under /dashboard/api/v1/ai/read answers ONE envelope (AnswerEnvelope), so a metric group added later changes only metricId, value and unit. GET scope answers what the caller may read for a period; GET money?metric= (H2) answers the money metrics (sales, cash and COD, profit and loss); GET customers?metric=, GET delivery?metric= and GET gallons?metric= (H3) answer the customer, delivery/courier and gallon metrics; GET stock?metric= and GET loyalty?metric= (H4) answer the stock group and the loyalty, promo, subscription and queue group; GET franchise?metric= and GET hr?metric= (H5) answer the franchise and legal-entity group and the HR group.

Authentication: the person's own AI-web token from POST /auth/api/v1/auth/handoff/token (auth.openapi.json): ES256, aud hydromart-ai, 15 minutes. A machine token (aud hydromart-machine) is refused with 403 whatever its scopes. The door is the aiRead capability: every staff role by default, franchise owners not.

Scope, applied in this order: (1) the person's own depots, exactly as hydromart-digital's own screens resolve them (a network-wide role: every depot); (2) narrowed to the depots whose legal entity, on a day of the period, is one the person's ROLE is granted in the role x legal entity matrix (HD-5). No grant = only SUPER_ADMIN reads it. A grant never widens step 1. The answer echoes the depots and legal entities it covered in scope. When hydromart-digital cannot work the scope out (a depot service that does not answer), nothing is answered: 503, never an answer without the narrowing.

Period: the WIB (Asia/Jakarta, UTC+7) calendar. Send period=day|week|month|year (with date, any day inside it; default today in WIB) OR from and to (YYYY-MM-DD, both days included, at most 366 days). Both or neither is a 400. Weeks run Monday to Sunday. The resolved period is always echoed back, with the same span as UTC instants (fromAt inclusive, toAt exclusive). A metric defined only over whole months or years refuses a range that is not a run of them (400).

value and status: ok = a real value, and 0 is a real value. belum_ada = there is nothing to say yet (not built, no data, not defined): value is null and reason says why; never read it as 0. ditahan = held back on purpose (masking, or a decision still open): value is null and reason says why. Quote the number from value, and the period and scope from the envelope.

Masking (owner decision 24 Nov 2026): no phone number, name or address ever leaves this API. Customers and couriers appear only as counts or opaque ids. A group of fewer than 3 people is not given as a number: its cell has value null and flag "kurang dari 3", and when a total is published beside it, the smallest other non-empty cell is held back with it (flag "ditahan") so the small cell cannot be computed back from the total; if there is no such cell the total itself is null with totalFlag "ditahan". A group of 0 people is shown as 0. Held-back cells are widened until at least 6 people are held back, so a held-back cell cannot be pinned down from the total; if the cells run out first the total is held back too. Two answers over overlapping windows are never published, because their difference would be a smaller group than either shows.

No personal data: every string, and every object key, is checked before an answer leaves. A field named phone, name, nama, address, alamat, email, hp and the like is refused, and so is any text that contains an email address or a phone number. A display name travels only under the field label. A label names a thing (a depot code, a product, a queue), never a person, and is checked like every other string. Amounts and counts are JSON numbers, never digit strings: a string of 10 to 13 digits that starts with 08, 62 or 8 reads as a phone number and is refused. A refused answer is a 500 with the fixed message "Jawaban ini tidak bisa dikirim." and never echoes what tripped the check.

Split by depot (AI-7a): split=depot, on the few metrics marked splittable in x-metrics (P-01, P-04, P-07, P-10 and G-01: scalar sums over depots, and the visits metrics V-01 to V-04), answers value { total, byDepot: [{ depotId, value }] } with total equal to the answer without split and every depot readable in the period listed once. Every other metric refuses it with 400, and so does any value but depot.

Read-only: nothing is written and nothing is recorded in the audit trail. Rate limit: counted per account (the token's sub), at the edge and again in the service; a 429 carries Retry-After.

Compatibility: a field may be added within version 1, so ignore a field you do not know; removing or renaming one is a new contract version. AI-21: GET visits?metric= answers supervisor visits as counts per depot (V-01 visits, V-02 days since the last visit, V-03 follow-ups, V-04 findings), and H-07 of GET hr answers turnover of one closed month. HD-16: GET targets?metric= answers the monthly depot goals (revenue, gallons, orders, new customers) against their actuals, { target, actual, pct }.

get.summary: How many depots the caller may read for a period, and which legal entities they belong to.
get.description: metricId meta.scope, unit depot. value is the number of depots in scope. When the caller may read no depot at all in the period the answer is status belum_ada with value null (never 0) and a reason. scope lists the depots and the legal entities they belonged to on a day of the period. depots (beside the envelope fields) names each depot in scope: { depotId, code, label }, label being the depot's display name. code and label are null only when depot-service could not name the depot. Absent when status is belum_ada. split is refused on this route with 400. A depot whose code or label would read as personal data (for example a phone number) is listed with both null.

400.description: BAD_REQUEST: a period that is ambiguous (both period and from/to, or neither), not a real day, backwards, longer than 366 days, or not whole where the metric needs it.

get.summary: One money metric (sales P-, cash and COD U-, profit and loss L-) for a period.
get.description:
The money group of the metric dictionary (sections 3.1, 3.3, 3.4). The metric is the `metric` query parameter; the answer is the AnswerEnvelope, with metricId, unit and the value shape fixed per metric in x-metrics. Amounts are whole rupiah as JSON numbers; percentages have one decimal. The period is WIB. Where a metric says "month only", an explicit from/to must be exactly one whole calendar month (400 otherwise).

Scope: every fact counts only for the days its depot was readable by the caller (a depot that changed legal entity in the period is read per stretch of days). The money metrics that are monthly profit-and-loss figures (L-01, L-03, L-06, L-07, L-08, L-09) are not cut in the middle of a month: a depot that was readable for only part of the month is left out of them, and scope lists the depots that WERE counted. When no depot is readable the answer is belum_ada.

label (optional, on the envelope): what the number is, where its name alone would mislead (for example L-03 says it is base pay and allowances only). Quote it beside the number.

People: none of these metrics counts people, so none is group-masked; the personal-data guard still runs on every answer.

Sources of truth: the numbers come from order-service, payment-service, delivery-service, depot-service and the same monthly profit-and-loss as /dashboard/network-pnl; a source that cannot answer makes the metric belum_ada (never 0). Money by payment (P-02, P-03, U-01, U-02, U-04, U-05): a delivery payment has no depot of its own, so it is placed by order-service. If order-service cannot place every delivery payment of the window, the metric is belum_ada, never a counter-only number. The 20000-order-row cap of one window is NETWORK-WIDE for delivery payments (counter payments are filtered by the depots asked); the upgrade path is an order-depot column on payments. A single answer that would need more than 300 one-depot reads is belum_ada ("persempit cakupan"). Only the metrics marked splittable in x-metrics accept split=depot (400 for the others).

Machine account (AI-31): the AI web's own machine account (a token with aud hydromart-machine holding the capability aiReadAgent, exchanged at POST /auth/api/v1/auth/machine/token) may call this route with no person signed in, for the scheduled agents. It reads the WHOLE network (every depot and legal entity, no role to narrow by), only the metrics P-01, U-02, U-04 and U-05 (403 for any other metric), and nothing else: every other route of this API answers 403 to it. Every machine read is written to the audit trail before it is answered (the actor is the machine account id); when the trail cannot be written the answer is 503 and nothing is read. Answers, masking and closed-period rules are the same as for a person.

split=depot on U-02, U-04 and U-05 (AI-31): value is { total, byDepot: [{ depotId, code, value }] } where each value has the same shape as the unsplit answer of that metric, total is the unsplit answer, byDepot lists every depot of the scope exactly once (an empty depot is a real zero), and code is the depot code (null when depot-service cannot name it).

Accepted only by P-01, P-04, P-07, P-10, U-02, U-04, U-05, G-01 (sums over depots, no people); any other metric, and any other value, is 400.

P-01.rules: Omzet: what was billed (after every discount, with shipping and VAT) on all orders except BATAL and VOID, by the day the order was created, before refunds, live orders only (no imported history, no gallon deposit). 0 is a real answer. belum_ada only when the order source cannot be read. With split=depot: value is { total, byDepot }; total is the unsplit answer (byDepot values are rounded on their own and may differ from the sum by at most 1 per depot), byDepot lists every depot the caller may read in the period exactly once (0 is a real value; a depot readable for only part of the period counts only those days). status and reason are the same as without split: when the source cannot be read the answer is belum_ada, never a partial list.

P-02.rules: Refunds actually paid back, by refund date, delivery and counter orders. refundIdr counts only orders that still count as sales; refunds of cancelled (batal) and void orders are given apart in refundOfCancelledAndVoidOrdersIdr. belum_ada when payment-service or order-service cannot be read.

P-03.rules: P-01 minus P-02.refundIdr, same period and scope.

P-04.rules: Orders except BATAL and VOID, by creation day, every channel. With split=depot: value is { total, byDepot }; total is the unsplit answer (byDepot values are rounded on their own and may differ from the sum by at most 1 per depot), byDepot lists every depot the caller may read in the period exactly once (0 is a real value; a depot readable for only part of the period counts only those days). status and reason are the same as without split: when the source cannot be read the answer is belum_ada, never a partial list.

P-05.rules: P-01 / P-04, rounded to a whole rupiah. belum_ada with no orders.

P-06.rules: cancelled = BATAL orders created in the period; ratePct = cancelled / (orders + cancelled), one decimal. VOID counts in neither. belum_ada with no orders and no cancellations.

P-07.rules: Orders DELIVERED or COMPLETED (TERKIRIM or SELESAI) created in the period. With split=depot: value is { total, byDepot }; total is the unsplit answer (byDepot values are rounded on their own and may differ from the sum by at most 1 per depot), byDepot lists every depot the caller may read in the period exactly once (0 is a real value; a depot readable for only part of the period counts only those days). status and reason are the same as without split: when the source cannot be read the answer is belum_ada, never a partial list.

P-08.value: { app: { orders, revenueIdr }, counter: { orders, revenueIdr } }
P-08.rules: P-04 and P-01 split into the app (delivery) and the counter. belum_ada with no orders.

P-09.rules: Top 10 products by line value (no shipping, no order-level discount), so the sum is below P-01. label is the product name. Exact: every product of every readable stretch is read, merged, and only then ranked. belum_ada with no sales, or when a stretch has more than 2000 products.

P-10.rules: Shipping billed on orders that are not BATAL or VOID; already inside P-01. With split=depot: value is { total, byDepot }; total is the unsplit answer (byDepot values are rounded on their own and may differ from the sum by at most 1 per depot), byDepot lists every depot the caller may read in the period exactly once (0 is a real value; a depot readable for only part of the period counts only those days). status and reason are the same as without split: when the source cannot be read the answer is belum_ada, never a partial list.

P-11.rules: Always belum_ada: VAT per period is not computed anywhere yet.

P-13.rules: Orders by weekday x hour (WIB) and the top 10 destination cities; otherAreas holds the rest. Exact: every city of every readable stretch is merged before the top 10 is cut. belum_ada with no orders, or when a stretch has more than 2000 cities.

P-14.rules: Always ditahan: one customer is a group of 1 person, which the masking rule holds back (fewer than 3). Pending an owner decision on whether a top-customers list may be given.

U-01.rules: Payments settled (LUNAS) by paid date, less what was refunded of them, per method; CASH includes COD and the counter. A part-refunded payment counts for what stayed.

U-02.rules: Payments still MENUNGGU that were created in the period, per method and per age bucket (0-1, 2-3, 4-7, 8+ WIB calendar days up to today). With split=depot: value is { total, byDepot: [{ depotId, code, value }] }; total is the unsplit answer, value has the unsplit shape for that depot, every depot of the scope is listed once and an empty depot is a real zero.

U-03.rules: Always belum_ada: receivables in rupiah are not computed anywhere yet.

U-04.value: { collectedIdr, depositedIdr, undepositedIdr, expectedIdr, shortfallIdr, surplusIdr }
U-04.rules: Three numbers: collectedIdr = cash settled on delivery orders by paid date; depositedIdr = courier deposits verified, by verification date; undepositedIdr = COD of orders delivered in the period that no deposit lists yet. expectedIdr = what the verified deposits were expected to be; shortfallIdr and surplusIdr are the short and the over of those deposits, each summed on its own (positive rupiah). belum_ada when a source cannot be read. Each figure follows its own depot, and the label says so: collectedIdr follows the depot of the ORDER; deposited, expected, shortfall and surplus follow the depot of the courier SHIFT that handed the cash in (one deposit can list orders of another depot, and deposits are lump sums, so they cannot be split per order); undepositedIdr follows the delivery depot. With split=depot: value is { total, byDepot: [{ depotId, code, value }] }; total is the unsplit answer, value has the unsplit shape for that depot, every depot of the scope is listed once and an empty depot is a real zero.

U-05.value: { cashIdr, shiftVariance: { shifts, shortfallIdr, surplusIdr } | { status: "belum_ada", reason } }
U-05.rules: Counter cash: CASH settled at the counter by paid date, no opening float. shiftVariance = counted minus expected cash of the till shifts closed in the period, short and over apart; if the shift source cannot be read that sub-number is {status: belum_ada, reason} inside the answer, never omitted and never 0. With split=depot: value is { total, byDepot: [{ depotId, code, value }] }; total is the unsplit answer, value has the unsplit shape for that depot, every depot of the scope is listed once and an empty depot is a real zero.

U-06.rules: Cashbook outflow less corrections, by transaction date, without stock-purchase categories. Outside net profit (L-07) but always to be named beside it.

U-07.rules: Days closed by the depots in the whole month; the sum of depot-days over the readable depots.

L-01.rules: HPP: units sold x the latest received PO buy price, no PO shipping. belum_ada when some unit sold has no buy price. For the running month the label says "bulan berjalan, sampai <today WIB>".

L-02.rules: Purchases received: POs completed in the period (goods x price + shipping), for cash flow only.

L-03.rules: Labour cost, for now BASE PAY AND ALLOWANCES ONLY (label: "gaji pokok dan tunjangan, belum termasuk bonus, lembur, THR dan BPJS perusahaan"). Only APPROVED or PAID slips count: a depot-month is finished when no slip is DRAFT and as many employees have an APPROVED or PAID slip as the month waits for (employed at any time in it: joined on or before its last day, not left before its first day; nobody expected = nothing to pay); any unfinished depot in scope makes the answer belum_ada, never 0. ditahan for a role without payrollRead.

L-04.rules: Courier commission, gross: earnings and incentives recorded in the period, by delivery depot.

L-05.rules: Approved expense claims by review date, by claim depot.

L-06.rules: Gross profit: revenue - HPP (L-01). belum_ada when HPP is. For the running month the label says "bulan berjalan, sampai <today WIB>".

L-07.rules: Net profit by the 17 Nov 2026 formula only: revenue - HPP - base pay and allowances (not bonus, overtime, THR, employer BPJS) - courier commission - expense claims - cashier refunds. Cashbook outflow is outside it; rent and electricity are not recorded. belum_ada when any element is unreadable or any depot-month payroll is not finished (as L-03: every employee of the month must have an approved or paid slip); ditahan for a role without payrollRead. The same numbers as /dashboard/network-pnl once the month is finished.

L-08.rules: L-07 / revenue, one decimal. belum_ada without profit or without revenue, or while payroll is not finished; ditahan like L-07.

L-09.rules: Net cash flow (arus kas, never "laba"): (revenue - refunds) - purchases received - salary paid - cashbook outflow. Its salary term takes every slip of the month, so it is belum_ada unless every depot-month payroll is finished (as L-03); ditahan for a role without payrollRead.

get.summary: One stock metric (stock now, count differences, wastage, water meter, purchasing, forecast) for a period.
get.description:
The stock group of the metric dictionary (section 3.7). The metric is the `metric` query parameter; the answer is the AnswerEnvelope, with metricId, unit and the value shape fixed per metric in x-metrics. Amounts are whole rupiah as JSON numbers; litres and gallons have at most two decimals; percentages one. The period is WIB.

S-01, S-05 and S-06 are about NOW: the period of the answer is today (WIB) whatever period is sent (a nonsense one is still 400; none at all is fine), and they count the depots the caller may read today. S-02, S-03 and S-04 count only the days each depot was readable by the caller (a depot that changed legal entity in the period is read per stretch of days).

People: none of these metrics counts people, so none is group-masked; the personal-data guard still runs on every answer. No answer carries a name, phone or address.

Sources of truth: depot-service (stock, purchase orders, counts, wastage), order-service (water meter) and forecast-service (forecast). A source that fails, times out, answers non-2xx or answers a depot nobody asked about makes the metric belum_ada (never 0, never a partial sum). A single answer that would need more than 300 one-depot reads is belum_ada ("persempit cakupan"). split=depot is refused here with 400: these metrics are people, network-only, ratio, object or point-in-time figures, and a per-depot answer beside a network answer would let a reader subtract small groups.

parameters.description: A whole calendar period in WIB. Not together with from/to.

parameters.description: Last day of an explicit range (included), with from.

400.description: BAD_REQUEST: a period that is ambiguous (both period and from/to, or neither), not a real day, backwards, longer than 366 days, or not whole where the metric needs it.

401.description: UNAUTHORIZED: no token, an expired one, or one hydromart-digital cannot verify. Hand off again for a new token, then retry.

403.description: FORBIDDEN: a machine token, or a person whose role does not hold aiRead (a franchise owner, by default). Not worth retrying until their role changes.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: a metric id that is not in this group of the dictionary.

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: too many calls from this account. Wait the seconds in Retry-After, then retry.

500.description: INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR: the answer was held back because it would have carried personal data (a bug in the metric, not in the request). The message is always "Jawaban ini tidak bisa dikirim."; retrying will not help.

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: the scope could not be worked out (the depot list or the legal-entity matrix could not be read). Nothing is answered rather than an answer without the narrowing. Retry later.

S-01.value: { depots, lines, lowLines, outLines, availableByType: { [itemType]: units }, byDepot: [{ depotId, lines, lowLines, outLines }] }
S-01.rules: Stock now: the period of the answer is TODAY (WIB) whatever period is sent (a nonsense period is still 400, none at all is fine), over the depots readable today. Hidden lines are not counted. available = quantity - reserved; lowLines = lines whose available is at most a minimum that is set (a minimum of 0 never makes a line low); outLines = lines with nothing available, a fact on its own. byDepot lists only the depots the caller may read today that have a visible line. belum_ada when no depot is readable today or a source cannot answer.

S-02.value: { byType: { [itemType]: { units, valueIdr, unpricedUnits } }, units, valueIdr, unpricedUnits }
S-02.rules: Stock count differences (opname) in the period: counted minus system, signed (minus = short). Counts HQ rejected are left out, but counts still WAITING for HQ approval are included (they may be rejected later, so the number can change; the label says so). Valued at the last purchase price on the day of each count (the most recent RECEIVED purchase order received on or before that day, by its received date; a line at 0 is no price), never the selling price; units with no purchase price are in unpricedUnits and NOT in valueIdr, so quote both. valueIdr is null only when something was counted and nothing could be priced. No count in the period is a real 0.

S-03.value: { byType: { [itemType]: { units, valueIdr, unpricedUnits } }, units, valueIdr, unpricedUnits }
S-03.rules: Wastage in the period: stock adjusted down (broken or lost) plus gallons handed back damaged, WITHOUT the gallons lent to customers with a delivery and without the reversal of a count HQ rejected. Units per item type, and rupiah at the last purchase price on the day of the loss (damaged gallons at the day of each return; most recent RECEIVED purchase order on or before that day, a line at 0 is no price; the newest 200 received orders of each depot are searched); unpriced units are in unpricedUnits and not in valueIdr. No loss in the period is a real 0.

S-04.value: { daysWithReading, meterLiters, soldLiters, varianceLiters, varianceGallons, varianceIdr, daysWithoutPrice, roYieldPct }
S-04.rules: Water meter over the days with a closing reading in the period: water out = (closing - opening) x 1000 litres; sold = litres of orders that are not BATAL or VOID created that WIB day (products with a volume); variance = out - sold; rupiah = variance gallons x that day's average selling price per gallon (decision 27-A). A day with a variance but no gallon sold has no price: varianceIdr is then null and daysWithoutPrice counts them (never a total that silently undercounts). roYieldPct is water out / raw water in over the days that metered the raw water too, weighted by litres (not a mean of daily percentages), else null. belum_ada when no closing reading was recorded in the period.

S-05.rules: Purchasing now (answered over today, whatever period is sent): purchase orders SENT and not fully received, valued at what is still expected ((ordered - received) x unit cost; a line closed short with a reason is not expected; shipping not included; drafts are not orders yet). No such order is a real 0.

S-06.rules: A FORECAST, never a fact (the label says so): predicted REVENUE ONLY (the per-product demand forecast is not served); predicted revenue for the next 7 days from today (WIB), from the last 30 days of history, summed over the depots readable today. The period of the answer is today whatever period is sent. belum_ada when the forecast service is not wired or any depot cannot be forecast.

get.summary: One loyalty, referral, promo-cost, subscription, campaign or open-queue metric (O-, A-). The people metrics are for ONE whole, closed calendar month, answered from the 8th of the next month.
get.description:
The loyalty group of the metric dictionary (section 3.8) and the open queues (3.11). The metric is the `metric` query parameter; the answer is the AnswerEnvelope.

People: O-02, O-04, O-06, O-08 and O-09 count people (redeemers, loyalty members, referees, subscribers, campaign recipients). No name, phone or address is ever read. Each is defined for ONE whole calendar month: a day, a week, a year, a range over two months or a range that is not a whole month is a 400, so two answers never overlap and cannot be subtracted to isolate the few people between them. Only a CLOSED month is answered, and only from the 8th of the next month (from 8 January for December), so late cancellations have settled; before that it is ditahan. A group of 1 or 2 people is not given as a number (ditahan, reason "kurang dari 3", or a cell with value null and flag "kurang dari 3"), and a total published beside held cells also holds the smallest neighbour back (flag "ditahan"). A total as of a date (O-04's accounts) is rounded to a multiple of 5.

The customer group of the metric dictionary (section 3.5). The metric is the `metric` query parameter; the answer is the AnswerEnvelope. Every metric counts people, so every one is defined for ONE whole calendar month (C-08 for a run of whole months): a day, a week, or a range that is not whole months is a 400. Only named customers count: the anonymous counter buyer is nobody. A person with two phone numbers is two customers (no merging).

Cells of 1 or 2 people are held back with their smallest neighbour; all cells held = ditahan. belum_ada with no named customer at all. Every cell and the total are rounded to a multiple of 5 always (a total as of two dates subtracts into the people who moved between them). Only depots whose whole history up to asOf the role may read are counted; heldBackDepots says how many were not, and the label names the day they became readable.

C-07.rules: Always ditahan: a churn score is one number per person (a group of 1, masking) and a forecast. Use C-06 for counts by days since the last order.

C-08.value: { cohorts: [{ cohort: "YYYY-MM", size: number | null, flag?: "kurang dari 3", months: [{ monthIndex, customers: number | null, ratePct: number | null, flag? }] }] }
C-08.rules: Retention by cohort: cohort = the WIB month of a customer's first order ever (named customers, not BATAL/VOID) in a readable depot and day; months[n] = customers of the cohort who ordered again n months later (in a readable depot and day), ratePct = customers / size with one decimal. A cohort or a cell of fewer than 3 people has value null and flag "kurang dari 3". Defined for a run of whole calendar months or a year; belum_ada when no new customer fell in them. A cohort is held back WHOLE (size null, flag "kurang dari 3") when any of its cells is under 3 people, or when 1 or 2 of its people did not come back (near-total retention shows them). Only a closed month is answered, and only from the 8th of the next month (from 8 January for December), so late cancellations have settled; before that it is ditahan. A group of 1 or 2 people is held back. Sizes and cells are ALWAYS multiples of 5 (percentages worked out from the rounded numbers); the held-back test is made on the exact counts first.

C-09.rules: Always ditahan: lifetime value is an amount per customer (a group of 1, masking).

C-10.rules: Rating: the mean stars of all reviews of orders created in the month (every review weighs the same), one decimal. Reviews from fewer than 3 different customers = ditahan. belum_ada with no review. Only a closed month is answered, and only from the 8th of the next month (from 8 January for December), so late cancellations have settled; before that it is ditahan. A group of 1 or 2 people is held back.

get.summary: One delivery or courier metric (K-: delivered, on time, median time, failed, courier group, live orders).
get.description:
The delivery group of the metric dictionary (section 3.6). K-01 to K-05 are answered for ONE whole calendar month only, and only a CLOSED one, answered from the 8th of the next month (from 8 January for December), so late cancellations have settled (before that it is ditahan): two nested periods (d1..d7 and d1..d6) would subtract into one courier's day, and a running month watched day by day steps by one courier. A day, a week, a range or a year is a 400. K-06 (a rating per courier) is never answered. K-07 is the state right now and ignores the period.

People: this group counts customers or couriers. No name, phone or address is ever read; a group of 1 or 2 people is not given as a number (ditahan, reason "kurang dari 3", or a cell with value null and flag "kurang dari 3"), and a total published beside held cells also holds the smallest neighbour back (flag "ditahan"). Courier identity is never sent: only how many couriers there were. A failure reason is free text a courier typed and can name a person, so only the no-show reason is counted apart; the rest is "otherReason" without text.

On time (K-02): the verdict stored when the delivery completed (depot threshold, else the network threshold; the clock starts at the courier's assignment and restarts when a CUSTOMER reschedules, not when the depot swaps the courier). Deliveries completed before the verdict was stored are graded again with the network threshold; the label says how many of each.

Scope and sources as for the other groups: delivery-service and order-service; belum_ada (never 0) when a source cannot answer or more than 100 depots are in scope.

Courier floor: in a depot or slice with 1 or 2 couriers the on-time share, the median minutes, the failures and the delivered count ARE that courier's record. So K-01 to K-05 answer ditahan ("kurang dari 3") unless 3 or more distinct couriers, counting those who delivered OR failed, are behind the slice. K-07 answers the state of TODAY: the period asked is not used, the scope is worked out for today, and the period echoed in the envelope is today. K-07 is a live figure: the difference between two readings is a change of orders, not of people. split=depot is refused here with 400: these metrics are people, network-only, ratio, object or point-in-time figures, and a per-depot answer beside a network answer would let a reader subtract small groups.

get.summary: Served (R-01) and unserved (R-02) demand per kecamatan, kelurahan or 1 km cell for ONE whole closed month.
get.description:
HD-20c, the areas of the metric dictionary. The metric is the `metric` query parameter, the month is `month` (YYYY-MM) and the cell size is `level` (kecamatan by default); the answer is the AnswerEnvelope with value { level, cells, total } (R-02 also bands and bandsTotal).

Cells: kecamatan and kelurahan are BPS codes (`id`) with their name (`label`); a grid cell is its id (`<floor(lat/0.009)>:<floor(lng/0.009)>`, about 1 km) with the centre of the cell (`lat`, `lng`). A cell with id null and label "tidak diketahui" holds orders with no delivery pin, or a pin outside every mapped kecamatan or kelurahan. No customer id, address or raw coordinate is ever returned.

People: R-01 counts customers, R-02 counts people (one row per customer per kecamatan per month whose pin lies outside every depot area; a second address in the same kecamatan adds nobody). A cell of 1 or 2 is not given as a number (customers null, or people null in R-02, flag "kurang dari 3"), the smallest neighbouring cells are held back with it (flag "ditahan") until a held cell cannot be pinned down by subtraction, the held people (each counted once) number 0 or at least 3 (at kelurahan level, inside each kecamatan too), and a total that would still give a held cell away is null. At grid level cells do not nest with kecamatan, so no hierarchy rule applies there. `orders` and `galon` of an R-01 cell are published only for a cell that is not held back. A customer who ordered into two cells counts in both, so cells of R-01 are not additive; `total` counts each customer once.

Month: only a CLOSED month is answered, and only from the 8th of the next month (8 January for December), so late cancellations settle first; before that the answer is ditahan. Two answers therefore never overlap.

Scope: R-01 counts the orders of the depots, and for the days each depot was readable, in the caller's scope (the same rule as the customer metrics); an order counts when it is not BATAL and not VOID and its customer is named. R-02 belongs to no depot, so only a role that reads every depot and every legal entity (and the AI web's machine account) is answered; any other is ditahan.

Sources of truth: order-service (pins), customer-service (regions, unserved demand). A source that cannot answer makes the answer belum_ada (never 0).

get.summary: B2B prospects now (B-01), conversions (B-02) or visits (B-03), per depot, kecamatan, kelurahan or 1 km cell, for ONE month.
get.description:
AREA-3, the prospects of the metric dictionary: the businesses (kos, schools, clinics, workshops ...) a depot could sell gallons to. The metric is the `metric` query parameter, the month is `month` (YYYY-MM) and the cell size is `level` (kecamatan by default); the answer is the AnswerEnvelope with value { level, cells, total }.

Cells: a depot cell is the depot id (`id`) and its name (`label`); kecamatan and kelurahan are BPS codes (`id`) with their name (`label`); a grid cell is its id (`<floor(lat/0.009)>:<floor(lng/0.009)>`, about 1 km) with the centre of the cell (`lat`, `lng`). A cell with id null and label "tidak diketahui" holds prospects with no known kecamatan or kelurahan. At depot level the cell with id null, `opportunity: true` and label "di luar area depot" is the opportunity bucket (prospects no depot serves). A cell carries `total` (prospects, or visits for B-03) and, for a cell that is not held back: `byCategory` (13 categories), `byStatus` (B-01: 6 statuses, never CONVERTED), `byOutcome` (B-03), `withPhone` and `withPhonePct` (0 to 100, one decimal; B-01), `dataAgeDaysMedian` (days since the source date, or the day it was added; B-01), `prospectsVisited` (distinct businesses visited; B-03). A breakdown is a list of { key, count, flag? }.

Never returned: any business name, phone, contact name, address, note, exact coordinate (a grid cell is its centre only), prospect id, customer id, assignee id, visitor id, source id or licence text.

Masking: a cell of 1 or 2 has `total` null and flag "kurang dari 3"; the smallest neighbouring cells are held back with it (flag "ditahan") until a held cell cannot be pinned down by subtraction, the held count is 0 or at least 3 (at kelurahan level, inside each kecamatan too), and a total that would still give a held cell away is null. The same rule holds inside every breakdown of a published cell (an entry of 1 or 2 is null with its flag; if the entries held cannot be hidden from the cell total, the whole breakdown is "ditahan"). `withPhone` and `withPhonePct` are null when either side (with a phone, without) is 1 or 2. `prospectsVisited` is null when it is 1 or 2. One month per call, so two answers never overlap.

Month: B-01 is the stock of prospects NOT yet converted, as of now (retention deletes history, so no past month exists): converted prospects are left out of its total and every breakdown, so all-time converted minus the published months can never give a held month away; converted counts exist only per month in B-02. `month` must be the running WIB month, any other is 400. B-02 (prospects that became customers in the month) and B-03 (accepted GPS visits in the month) are stamped when they happen and cannot be backdated: a closed month is answered from day 1 of the next month; before that the answer is ditahan.

Scope: a caller sees the prospects whose OWNER depot it may read (so a region cell never mixes in another depot's prospects): for B-02 and B-03 a depot counts only when the caller's grant covers every day of the month (a depot that joined a readable legal entity mid-month is left out of that month), for B-01 only when it covers today; a depot left out is simply not counted. Only a role that reads every depot and every legal entity also gets the opportunity bucket (and the prospects no depot serves inside every region cell); any other caller never does. A caller with no depot gets belum_ada. Not open to the machine account.

Source of truth: customer-service (the B2B prospect table). A source that cannot answer makes the answer belum_ada (never 0).

401.description: UNAUTHORIZED: no token, an expired one, or one hydromart-digital cannot verify. Hand off again for a new token, then retry.

403.description: FORBIDDEN: a machine token, or a person whose role does not hold aiRead (a franchise owner, by default). Not worth retrying until their role changes.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: a metric id that is not in the prospects group (B-01, B-02, B-03).

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: too many calls from this account. Wait the seconds in Retry-After, then retry.

500.description: INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR: the answer was held back because it would have carried personal data (a bug in the metric, not in the request). The message is always "Jawaban ini tidak bisa dikirim."; retrying will not help.

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: the scope could not be worked out (the depot list or the legal-entity matrix could not be read). Nothing is answered rather than an answer without the narrowing. Retry later.

B-01.rules: Prospects on the map as of now that have NOT converted (status CONVERTED is excluded from total and every breakdown; byStatus has 6 keys), per cell: total, byCategory, byStatus, withPhone and withPhonePct, dataAgeDaysMedian. The month must be the running month (400 otherwise). No closed-month wait: it is a snapshot. A cell of 1 or 2 is held back with its smallest neighbours.

B-02.rules: Prospects that became customers in the month (by the day they converted), per cell: total and byCategory. Rows anonymised after 12 months still count. A closed month is answered from day 1 of the next month; before that it is ditahan. A cell of 1 or 2 is held back with its smallest neighbours.

B-03.rules: Accepted GPS visits in the month, per cell of the visited prospect (its current owner depot and region): total visits, prospectsVisited (distinct businesses) and byOutcome. A closed month is answered from day 1 of the next month; before that it is ditahan. A cell of 1 or 2 visits is held back with its smallest neighbours.

get.summary: One supervisor-visit metric (visits made V-01, days since the last visit V-02, follow-ups V-03, findings V-04) for a period.
get.description:
AI-21, the visits group: supervisors' visits to depots as COUNTS per depot. The metric is the `metric` query parameter; the answer is the AnswerEnvelope, with metricId, unit and the value shape fixed per metric in x-metrics. The period is WIB.

V-01 and V-04 are counted over the period (a depot that changed legal entity mid-period counts only the days it was readable). V-02 and V-03 are about NOW: the period of the answer is today (WIB) whatever period is sent (a nonsense one is still 400; none at all is fine), over the depots the caller may read today.

split=depot: V-01 and V-04 answer { total, byDepot: [{ depotId, value }] }; V-02 is only answered with it ({ byDepot: [{ depotId, days }] }, days null = never visited; without it the answer is belum_ada); V-03 answers { open, overdue } and, with it, adds byDepot: [{ depotId, open, overdue }].

Never returned: the visitor, a finding text or note, a photo, a visit or checklist-line id. No metric counts people, so none is group-masked; the personal-data guard still runs on every answer. Source of truth: depot-service (visits and checklist lines). A source that fails, times out, answers non-2xx or answers a depot nobody asked about makes the metric belum_ada (never 0, never a partial sum). Needs the aiRead capability, the role x legal entity grant like every other group, and the visitRead capability (kepala depot, asisten supervisor, supervisor, manager, kantor pusat, direktur, super admin): any other role gets status ditahan with a reason, value null; the data group `visits` can be named in an access request.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: A metric of this group. Any other id is 404; leaving it out is 400.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: A whole calendar period in WIB. Not together with from/to.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Any day inside the period; default today in WIB. Only with period.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day of an explicit range, with to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day of an explicit range (included), with from.

parameters.name: split
parameters.description: Optional. depot = answer per depot (see the description for each metric's shape). Any other value is 400.

400.description: BAD_REQUEST: a period that is ambiguous (both period and from/to, or neither), not a real day, backwards, longer than 366 days, or not whole where the metric needs it.

401.description: UNAUTHORIZED: no token, an expired one, or one hydromart-digital cannot verify. Hand off again for a new token, then retry.

403.description: FORBIDDEN: a machine token, or a person whose role does not hold aiRead (a franchise owner, by default). Not worth retrying until their role changes.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: a metric id that is not in this group of the dictionary.

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: too many calls from this account. Wait the seconds in Retry-After, then retry.

500.description: INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR: the answer was held back because it would have carried personal data (a bug in the metric, not in the request). The message is always "Jawaban ini tidak bisa dikirim."; retrying will not help.

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: the scope could not be worked out (the depot list or the legal-entity matrix could not be read). Nothing is answered rather than an answer without the narrowing. Retry later.

V-01.rules: Supervisor visits that were COMPLETED, by the WIB day of completion, at the depots (and on the days) the caller may read. A visit still in progress is not counted. 0 is a real answer. With split=depot: { total, byDepot: [{ depotId, value }] }, every depot readable in the period listed once. belum_ada when depot-service cannot answer.

V-02.rules: Days since the last COMPLETED visit of any time, as of today (WIB), per depot; days is null for a depot never visited. Only answered with split=depot (a network figure would hide the depot that was never visited): without it the answer is belum_ada. Point in time: the period of the answer is today. belum_ada when no depot is readable today or depot-service cannot answer.

V-03.rules: Follow-ups of findings of completed visits that are still open now (open, overdue ones included) and the ones past their deadline (overdue: deadline before today, WIB). With split=depot, byDepot: [{ depotId, open, overdue }]. Point in time: the period of the answer is today. belum_ada when no depot is readable today or depot-service cannot answer.

V-04.rules: Checklist lines marked as a finding (TEMUAN) on completed visits, by the WIB day the visit was checked in. 0 is a real answer. With split=depot: { total, byDepot: [{ depotId, value }] }. belum_ada when depot-service cannot answer.

aiToken.description: Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> from POST /auth/api/v1/auth/handoff/token. ES256, aud hydromart-ai; carries the person's own role and depot.

machineToken.description: The AI web's own machine account (AI-31). ES256, aud hydromart-machine, scopes [aiReadAgent]; read-only, whole network, only the metrics the money route names for it.

metricId.description: The dictionary code of the metric (for example P-01), or meta.* for an answer about the API itself.

value.description: The number or structure answered. Null with belum_ada and ditahan, never 0. With split=depot on a splittable metric: a DepotSplit.

unit.description: For example rupiah, persen, menit, depot, galon, orang.

asOf.description: When the answer was read, UTC.

reason.description: Present with belum_ada and ditahan: why, in words that can be quoted. Never carries personal data.

label.description: Optional. What the number is, where its name alone would mislead (for example "gaji pokok dan tunjangan" on L-03). Quote it beside the number. A label names a thing, never a person.

depots.description: Only on the scope answer: the depots in scope, for naming a depot the AI web ranks. A depot name is business data, not personal data; it travels under label.

fromAt.description: The start of from, as a UTC instant (included).

toAt.description: The start of the day after to, as a UTC instant (excluded).

depotIds.description: The depots the answer covers: the caller's own depots, narrowed by the legal-entity matrix.

legalEntityIds.description: The legal entities those depots belonged to during the period, among the ones the caller's role may read.

MaskedCell.description: A group of people in a metric that counts them. Defined here so every later metric answers the same shape.

value.description: Null when held back; see flag.

flag.description: kurang dari 3: the group has 1 or 2 people. ditahan: held back only so a published total cannot give a small cell away.

code.description: BAD_REQUEST, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, RATE_LIMITED, INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR or SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.

message.description: For people reading logs. Route on statusCode and code.

DepotSplit.description: The value of a splittable metric asked with split=depot.

total.description: Exactly the answer without split (the rounded sum of all depots).

byDepot.description: Each value is rounded on its own, so the values can differ from total by at most 1 per depot (only metrics in rupiah round); total itself is always the unsplit answer.
